world.tone: Low-magic Western fantasy: rain, mud and steel. Knightly orders, wandering clerics and sellswords on a lawless river frontier. Terse, grounded, a little grim.
world.background: The Order of the Pale Sun claims every holy relic in the river march as its own, and its knights collect them by oath or by sword. The king's law stops at the city walls; out here, toll-keepers, priests and whoever holds the bridge make the rules.
laws: Plate armor turns aside cuts and arrows, but joints and the visor slit are weak points; a knight in plate is slow, and in deep mud or water he sinks.
Prayer magic needs a spoken prayer and a steady breath; a cleric struck or shoved mid-prayer loses the blessing.
An oath sworn on the Pale Sun binds the one who swears it; breaking it in front of witnesses is a public disgrace every knight of the Order is bound to answer.
Coin talks on the frontier: a toll-keeper, a guard or a ferryman can be bought, but a bought ally sells again to the next bidder.

scene.location: Greywater Bridge at dusk, in heavy rain: a narrow stone bridge over a flooded river, a toll gate with a hanging lantern at the near end, an overturned hay cart blocking half the span.
scene.hook: Sir Aldric Vane steps out from behind the toll gate in rain-dark plate and plants his shield on the stones. 'The relic in your pack belongs to the Order, Rowan. Give it up and cross in peace.' Brother Tam grips his flask of holy water at Rowan's shoulder; on the cart, Mags the toll-keeper watches with her hands in her apron.

player.name: Rowan
player.backstory: A sellsword in her late twenties with a short sword and a long memory. She was hired to carry a sealed reliquary to the free city of Ostwick and has not asked what is inside.
player.voice: Short, flat sentences; jokes when it gets dangerous.
player.motive: Get the reliquary and Tam across the bridge and get paid.
tactics: fight dirty if she has to
weaknesses: no answer to plate armor in a straight fight

tam.name: Brother Tam
tam.backstory: A young wandering cleric, nineteen, who hired Rowan in the last village. He says the reliquary must reach the Abbess of Ostwick before the Order buries it.
tam.voice: Speaks fast, quotes scripture when frightened.
tam.motive: Get the reliquary to Ostwick without anyone learning how he came by it.
abilities: a prayer of warding that can blunt one blow
a short prayer that steadies the wounded
defenses: Rowan stands between him and danger
weaknesses: loses his prayer if he is struck or shoved mid-word
freezes when a knight of the Order raises a voice at him

aldric.name: Sir Aldric Vane
aldric.backstory: A knight of the Pale Sun in his forties, sent alone to recover a relic stolen from the Order's chapel. He believes in the Order's law more than its leaders do.
aldric.voice: Measured and formal; never raises his voice.
aldric.motive: Recover the relic and bring the thief to judgment, without shedding blood if he can avoid it.
abilities: trained knight with sword and shield
weaknesses: cannot swim, and fears the flooded river (secret)
the strap on his left greave was split in the rain and gives under a hard twist

mags.name: Mags
mags.backstory: The toll-keeper of Greywater Bridge for thirty years. She knows every loose stone on it and sells that knowledge to whoever pays.
mags.motive: Come out of tonight richer, with the bridge still standing and no blood on her gate.
tactics: ducks behind the cart when steel comes out
abilities: keeps a loaded crossbow under her apron
defenses: nobody wants to kill the toll-keeper in front of witnesses
weaknesses: any offer of silver gets her attention

player.posture: Standing at the near end of the bridge, the reliquary strapped across her back

tam.posture: A step behind Rowan, clutching a flask of holy water

aldric.posture: Blocking the bridge beside the toll gate, shield planted, sword still sheathed

status_effects.content: Wearing full plate on wet stone
status_effects.gates: Slow to turn and move; footing is poor near the slick edges and the cart

mags.posture: Sitting on the overturned cart, hands in her apron

spatial.content: The bridge is only wide enough for one person beside the overturned cart
spatial.gates: Whoever holds the gap blocks everyone else

scene_facts.content: Heavy rain; the river below is flooded and fast
scene_facts.gates: Anyone who goes over the edge is swept downstream

scene_facts.content: The parapet stones on the downstream side near the cart are loose
scene_facts.gates: A hard shove there can send someone, and the stones, into the river

social_facts.content: Aldric has offered safe passage if the relic is handed over
social_facts.gates: Breaking that offer in front of witnesses would shame him before the Order

social_facts.content: Tam stole the reliquary from the Order's chapel vault
social_facts.gates: If it comes out, Rowan's contract and Tam's claim both fall apart

plans: If it comes to a fight, keep Aldric away from Tam and get across.
